exposure: Ultrasound fetal weight estimation using Hadlock 1, Hadlock 2, Hadlock 3, Hadlock 4, and Shepard formulas
outcome: Mean difference between estimated fetal weight and actual birth weight
cohort: 356 pregnant women within 3 days of birth at Mulago National Referral Hospital, Kampala, Uganda
finding: All five formulas (Hadlock 1, Hadlock 2, Hadlock 3, Hadlock 4, and Shepard) were accurate at estimating actual birth weights within 10%, but accuracy varied with fetal birth weight, with Shepard being more accurate for weights < 4000 g and Hadlock formulas more accurate for weights ≥4000 g.
